name: Kim Min-jun
action: Min-jun rocks Seo-yeon gently, glances down at her sleeping face, then his gaze drifts to his phone in his pocket. He looks back at Mr. Park with a friendly but hesitant smile and says, "That sounds nice, actually. What time does it start, and how long do people usually stay? I want to make sure it fits before Seo-yeon's bedtime. I haven't played since college, so I'd be rusty—but I've been meaning to get out a bit more." He pauses, rubbing his thumb along the carrier strap, and adds, "I'll check my schedule and let you know by the end of the week, if that's all right."
reason: Min-jun's Saturday evening was his application block, and he had planned to send two more job drafts. But badminton reminded him of a college semifinal with his roommate, and he recalled that his best job lead had come from a casual playground conversation, not his spreadsheet. He wanted to go and feel like someone who plays for no reason, but he needed to assess the cost first. So he asked Mr. Park about the start time and duration to see if it would end before Seo-yeon's bedtime and not consume his whole block, and said he would check his schedule before committing.
